exclusions.reason: The measured exposures are plasma sphingolipid metabolic enzyme proteins (e.g., SPHK1), with ceramides mentioned only incidentally as a lipid class function, so no ceramide exposure estimate for bladder cancer incidence exists.
Iron-driven renal carcinogenesis was studied experimentally in Brca1 mutant rats with tissue/molecular and TCGA tumor analyses, not in a human population exposure-incidence design.
This is a systematic review synthesizing prospective cohort studies of dietary exposures and urothelial cancer incidence rather than an original human study.
This is a systematic review of prospective cohort evidence on diet and bladder cancer risk, not primary data collection.
This is a systematic review of dietary exposures, including tea, and bladder cancer incidence rather than an original study.
The article is a narrative/critical review of saccharin chemistry, toxicology, and risk assessment without original human incidence data.
Alcohol intake is only one component of a composite healthy lifestyle index analyzed jointly with HLA alleles, and no alcohol-specific kidney cancer incidence estimate is reported.
The report uses Mendelian randomization or genetic instruments, which this protocol excludes.
